title: Hold pattern and variance controls — personal rollout notebook
content:
Context and goal:
- Quick brain-dump for a slow, low-risk model swap across hosted + dedicated pools. Not a formal runbook, but the steps I want to try next week during the quiet window. Keep conservative: prefer pin-and-hold over big flips.

Assumptions:
- Model v3-small-quant is compatible fallback for v4 at 8k context.
- Dedicated pools A/B have separate warm caches; cross-pool traffic creates cold misses.
- Console has per-model token counters and per-route p95/p99 latency.

High-level plan:
1) Prep: create traffic mirror route (mirror-quiet-2026-03) to stream 1% traffic to v4; no client-facing change. Verify logs and token profiles for 48h.
2) Shadow warmup: enable shadow requests (10% of gradients) on dedicated-A for 6h to prefill KV caches. Watch cache-hit rate and backend CPU.
3) Small cohort flip: 0.5% user base (non-critical cohorts) for 2h -> observe errors, hallucination score on eval prompts, token cost delta.
4) Hold-pattern: if p95 delta < 50ms and error rate < 0.1% and quality regression < 1.5% on eval set, keep at cohort for 24h.
5) Gradual ramp: steps = [0.5, 2, 8, 20, 50] percent, each with min observation window 2h, longer for the 20->50 jump (4h).
6) Full flip or pinback: if any threshold breached, execute pinback sequence (see shortcuts).

Gating thresholds (quick reference):
- infra errors (5xx) spike: > 0.05% absolute increase => immediate pinback.
- latency: p95 increase > 100ms at route level => pause and investigate.
- quality: any significant regression on the smoke eval suite (>1.5% composite) => rollback.
- token cost: sustained > 10% cost increase w/out latency improvement => discuss with finance.

Pinback (fast lanes):
- Route-level traffic switch via console: rollback route -> previous pinned model. Command shortcut: curl -X POST $CONSOLE/api/v1/routes/switch -d '{"route":"/chat","to_pin":"v3-small-quant"}' (ops-only).
- If console unavailable: use infra toggle (feature-flag: model-routing-default) -> flip to pinned model.

Monitoring checklist (live):
- p50/p95/p99 latency per-route and per-region
- 5xx and 4xx counts by client-id (spike detection)
- Token-per-response distribution and avg token cost per 1k responses
- Quality evaling: run 25 seed prompts every 10m against both active and pinned models; auto-alert if composite score delta > threshold
- Cache-hit% and KV-prefill delta per GPU pool

Client/cohort selection heuristics:
- Prefer cohorts with low prompt length variance first (short prompts) to reduce cold KV pressure.
- Avoid high-throughput streaming-heavy clients until 8am PST next day after starting warmup.
- Use cookie/client-id affinity to keep cohort sticky during ramp.

Notes on warmup and caches:
- Observed last time: initial 30-45m had elevated p99 due to KV cache misses for long-chat clients. To mitigate: pre-warm by replaying last-24h prefixes at 0.1x rate into the new pool (replay-job: replay-api/2026-02-prefill).
- TTLs for prefix cache are currently 6h; consider temporary bump to 12h for early stage of rollout. Discuss with infra if this impacts memory on dedicated pools.

Runbook snippets / quick commands:
- Check p99 by region: kpi-query --route /chat --metric latency_p99 --window 15m --group-by region
- Switch single cohort: console->routes->edit->traffic split (API: PATCH /api/route/split)
- Force pinback from CLI: rwinf rollback --route /chat --to v3-small-quant --reason "pinback auto"

Open questions / follow-ups:
- Who should be on pager for the first 0.5% flip? Suggest SRE+oncall + runtime lead + product-eng on standby.
- Do we want to test different quantization profiles in parallel for a subset of internal traffic? Maybe later.
- Need an automated nightly job to snapshot model metrics to S3 for post-rollout regression.

Post-mortem template (quick):
- Dates/times of flips and holds
- Metrics at decision points (latency, errors, quality, cost)
- Root cause and mitigation steps
- Action items and owners (e.g., cache TTL change, prefill job tuning)

Misc scribbles:
- Consider a 'soft pin' flag that keeps a model pinned for traffic shaping but still allows shadowing of v4 for quality tests.
- Add a console visualization for cache-hit curves during warmup windows.

End of notes — save and iterate. Will convert to proper runbook if first two flips go clean.

Quick log: 2026-03-03 09:12 — chatted with Priya, she suggested lowering the early cohort from 1% -> 0.5% and adding the 25-seed eval. My note: implement seed-runner as a cron job that pings both endpoints and stores diffs.
